In subfigure (b), the vertical axis is marked with amplitudes 1 and 0.5, and the spectrum enters the roll-off region from the flat top; the figure uses a dashed line to mark the position where the amplitude is 0.5, corresponding to the horizontal-axis frequency labeled 900 Hz, and a 1200 Hz label can also be seen nearby. Reasoning: The problem states that this system uses a raised-cosine roll-off waveform, and the symbol rate is 1/T. method.method_draft: Read from the text that the pulse is a raised-cosine pulse and the symbol rate is 1/T. From subplot (b), read that the normalized spectral value is 0.5 at f=900 Hz. Apply the raised-cosine fact that the 0.5 point of the transition occurs at f=1/(2T). Solve 1/(2T)=900 to obtain 1/T=1800 Baud.
